name: browser-use
headline: Medusa - AI Development Control Center
short_description: Medusa is a desktop app that serves as a control center for AI-powered development with Claude Code. It allows users to review plans before execution and run parallel agents. Developers and operations teams benefit from streamlined workflows and improved efficiency in managing AI agents.
author: benodiwal

sections.overview:
Medusa is a desktop control center for AI-powered development workflows built around Claude Code. It enables developers and operations teams to review AI agent plans before execution and run multiple agents in parallel. The tool streamlines agent management and execution, reducing manual overhead in development processes. Medusa is designed for teams seeking better visibility and control over their AI-assisted development pipelines.
Review and approve AI-generated development plans before execution
Run multiple AI agents simultaneously for parallel task processing
Centralize AI agent management across development workflows
Monitor and control Claude Code agent activities from a single interface
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/benodiwal/medusa`
sections.usage:
```
I'm using Medusa to [TASK] for [COMPANY]. Here's my plan: [PLAN]. Can you review it and suggest improvements before I execute it with parallel agents?
```
Copy

```
# Plan Review and Optimization for [COMPANY]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
